summary: National Health Investors (NHI) amended its 8-K to correct the date of a Purchase and Sale Agreement, entered April 21, 2026, under which NHI sells 32 skilled nursing and 3 independent living facilities to NHC/OP, L.P., a wholly-owned subsidiary of National HealthCare Corporation (NHC), for $560 million cash. The properties are currently leased to the purchasers under a master lease. A $5 million non-refundable deposit is due within 5 business days; purchasers may terminate for any reason during a review period ending May 29, 2026. Closing mechanics and regulatory timeline are not specified. Watch for review period outcome; risk-arb centers on termination risk and closing adjustments.
